role: Renders an EntityCreeper: the creeper model with the flash-white pulse as the fuse runs down, and the charged-creeper armor overlay pass.
scope_reason: Creepers are core gated content (fight-creeper-s1 and the mob scenes).

members.name: armoredCreeperTextures
members.note: TEX_CREEPER_ARMOR, drawn in the charged overlay pass in raster_mobs_draw (uv scroll 0.01/tick, 50% grey material, additive blend)

members.name: creeperModel
members.note: model_creeper builds the creeper geometry, armor variant grows boxes by 2

members.name: preRenderCallback
members.note: the flash scale pulse (1 + sin(flash * 100) * flash * 0.01) is in the shared transform's creeper branch in raster_mobs.c

members.name: getColorMultiplier
members.note: the flash whitening (flash^4 toward white) is in the vertex colour path of raster_mobs.c (the flash/pulse/fourth computation)

members.name: shouldRenderPass
members.note: the charged armor layer: TEX_CREEPER_ARMOR with additive blend, no depth write, uv scroll by age + partialTick

members.name: inheritRenderPass
members.note: hurt-flash inheritance hook; the hurt flash is the shared RendererLivingEntity pass in raster_mobs.c

notes: The flash intensity itself (getCreeperFlashIntensity, EntityCreeper state) is server-side creeper state the dump carries; the render-side pulse math is verified in raster_mobs.c. fight-creeper-s1 gates the swelling behaviour end to end.
